The simulation models liquid dodecane spray combustion in a 2D axisymmetric cylindrical chamber of 0.2 m length and 0.1 m diameter using OpenFOAM.
The injector is a cone-type nozzle centered on the axis of symmetry at the inlet face, injecting liquid dodecane at a mass flow rate of 0.002 kg/s and a temperature of 300 K.
The droplet size distribution is Rosin-Rammler with a mean diameter of 50 micrometers (50e-6 m).
The droplet gas-phase heat and mass transfer model is RanzMarshall and the drag model is standard.
The air co-flow enters the inlet at a temperature of 800 K, an axial velocity of 10 m/s, a pressure of 101325 Pa, with mass fractions Y_O2 = 0.233 and Y_N2 = 0.767.
The turbulence model is k-epsilon with standard wall functions.
At the inlet, k is set to a fixed value of 0.375 m²/s² and epsilon is set to a fixed value of 1.27 m²/s³, both derived from a 5 percent turbulence intensity with a mixing length of 0.07 times the chamber diameter.
At the outlet, the pressure boundary condition is totalPressure at 101325 Pa and all remaining fields (U, T, Y_O2, Y_N2, Y_nC12H26, Y_CO, Y_H2O, Y_CO2, k, epsilon) use zeroGradient.
The cylindrical wall uses noSlip velocity and a fixed temperature of 400 K, with wallFunction for k and epsilonWallFunction for epsilon.
The axis of symmetry uses the axis boundary condition for all fields.
The initial condition fills the entire chamber with air at 800 K and zero velocity.
The combustion model is finite-rate kinetics with a global two-step mechanism for nC12H26 oxidation and janaf thermodynamic tables.
Step 1 of the mechanism is nC12H26 + 12.5 O2 → 12 CO + 13 H2O with a pre-exponential factor of 1.0e14 m³/(kg·s) and an activation energy of 2.0e7 J/kg.
Step 2 of the mechanism is 12 CO + 6 O2 → 12 CO2 with a pre-exponential factor of 1.0e15 m³/(kg·s) and an activation energy of 1.7e7 J/kg.
The species declared in the reaction scheme are nC12H26, O2, N2, CO, H2O, and CO2.
The reaction definitions and kinetic parameters are written in constant/reactionSchemes and the thermodynamic and reacting model settings are written in constant/combustionProperties with thermoType set to janaf and reactingModel set to finiteRate.
The solver is compressibleReactingParcelFoam running in 2D axisymmetric mode.
The total simulation time is 0.05 s with an adjustable time step constrained by maxCo = 0.7.
Results are written every 0.001 s (writeInterval = 0.001).
